choices.label: Search for the Bugs All Night

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) takes the mat apart, strand by strand, by firelight. By morning (he/she) has found the culprits and carried them a long way from camp. (He/she) is exhausted, and also very proud.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) decides the bugs can have the mat and sleeps on the bare ground. This turns out to be a mistake. The bugs follow.
